Commentary.Commentary: Do England have a chance? We have seen low scores being defended before. Will we see that today? South Africa will come out to bat for a short while before the scheduled break. Stay tuned for the chase.

Jonny Bairstow was the only English batsman who wanted to spend some time out in the middle, his 51 runs helped England cross the 100-run mark. He got good support from the debutante, Toby Roland-Jones who stuck it out there. South Africa have never beaten England at Lord's and they have a very good chance here. The Proteas will be backing themselves to chase this target down.

Top bowling from South Africa but decent recovery by England! The hosts were asked to bat first and after being 20/6 at one stage, they have crawled their way to 153. The visitors bowled brilliantly at the start, running through the hosts' top order. Rabada the pick of the bowlers for the away side, ending up with figures off 4 for 39 in his 9 overs. Parnell and Maharaj backed him up well picking three wickets each.

OUT! Job well done, South Africa! Maharaj bowls it on the stumps, Finn looks to clip it over the leg side but does not keep it down. AB de Villiers goes to his right from short mid-wicket and takes a dolly. This is a superb performance from the visitors. ENGLAND HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 153.
BOUNCER! The batsman ducks under the short ball on the stumps.
Short ball, the batsman goes for the pull, gets a top edge. The ball lands in the vacant mid-wicket region and the batsmen run two.
Full toss on middle, Finn drives it down the ground for a run.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Drifts on the pads, Finn misses the flick, it brushes his pads and goes down to fine leg. Morkel was slow to get to the ball and hence the batsmen take a couple.

Short ball, Roland-Jones goes for the pull, gets a top edge and flies over the keeper, Morkel from fine leg makes good ground and dives and pushes the ball away. Morris from third man comes and collects the ball and throws it to the keeper. They run three.
Floats it up on leg stump, Finn flicks it to fine leg for a couple.
Steven Finn is the last man in. Can he help England get past 150?

OUT! One shot too many! Maharaj bowls it on the stumps, Ball sits down on his knee to sweep it. He gets an inside edge which goes onto hit his back leg and deflects onto the stumps. Maharaj takes his second wicket and that is it for Jake Ball.
FOUR! What a shot! Maharaj tosses it up, Ball comes down the track and lofts it inside out over the cover region for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
A short leg and leg slip in place now.
Flatter ball on off, Ball defends it off the back foot.

MISSED STUMPING! Difficult for de Kock. Maharaj tosses the ball up, Ball goes for a flick but misses it. He drags his feet out in the process, de Kock is blinded and is not able to collect and the ball rolls towards fine leg. The umpire signals it runs for he reckons there was an inside edge there.
Time for Drinks.
Full ball on off, Ball pushes it to covers for a run.
Three slips in place now.
WIDE! Goes full, but drifts down the leg side, Ball misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
Short ball, Roland-Jones pulls it down to deep backward square leg for a run.
Lands it on a length, Roland-Jones shows the full face of the bat and defends it.
Back of a length ball, Roland-Jones defends it off the back foot.
Full on middle, the batsman drives it to mid on.
Walks into a drive and the ball beats the outside edge.
Flatter ball, Ball defends it off the back foot.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
Tossed up, Ball defends it off the back foot.
Jake Ball strides out to the middle.

OUT! Stumped by a distance! Maharaj floats it outside off, Bairstow comes down the wicket to go inside out over covers but misses. The keeper takes the bails off in a flash and that is it for the English batsman. Not sure if he needed to play that shot. De Kock had ages to stump him there.
Flatter on the pads, turned through square leg for a single.

Loud shout for LBW!  But given not out and the South Africans decide to review it. They go upstairs, the decision remains the same. Maharaj tosses it up, Roland- Jones comes on the front foot and tries to defend it but misses the line and gets struck on the pads. The ball pitches in line, impact is in line but is just clipping the bails. So it remains umpire's call and Roland-Jones survives.
A loud appeal for an lbw against Roland-Jones not given. AB de Villiers reviews it. Looks close.
Short on the chest of the batsman, Roland-Jones tucks it to fine leg for a run.
Short again and Roland-Jones ducks under it.
BOUNCER! A well-directed short ball, but the batsman ducks under it and de Kock jumps and gathers the ball.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Back of a length ball, Roland-Jones guides it to the point region.
FOUR! WOW! What a shot from Roland-Jones. Rabada goes full on the middle stump, Roland-Jones drives it straight back past mid on for a boundary. Fifty-run stand between the two.
Flatter ball on the stumps, Bairstow punches it off the back foot to mid on.
Short outside off, Bairstow goes for the cut but is beaten.
Defends the flighted delivery off the front foot.
5th ODI fifty for Jonny Bairstow, back-to-back at Lord's!
FOUR! Superb by Bairstow! The bowler tosses it up, Bairstow goes down on one knee and sweeps it past short fine leg for a boundary to bring up his fifty.
Comes down the track and defends it back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, lands on off stump comes in with the arm, Bairstow goes to defend it but gets hit on the pads. There is a half appeal but it might be missing leg.
Keshav Maharaj comes on for a bowl.
Full ball on the pads, Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket and they run three.
The drizzle is getting heavy now.
FOUR! DEFT TOUCH! Length ball outside of, Bairstow opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a boundary. Bairstow is playing a good knock here.
Full ball, Bairstow drives it to mid on.

WHAT A STOP! Duminy with a brilliant diving stop to his right. Back of a length ball, Bairstow drives it on the up but can't beat Duminy at point who dives to his right and stops it from going through.
Lands it on a length on off stump, Bairstow defends it off the front foot
Back of a length ball, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
Kagiso Rabada returns for a burst.
Slants across a length delivery just outside off, Roland-Jones looks to play it through the off side but is beaten all ends up.
There is a slight drizzle.
Good length outside off, Roland-Jones defends it.
On a good length just around off, punched towards the off side.
Bowls it outside off, a mistimed drive back to the bowler.

FOUR! Poor work, Rabada! Shorter this time but wide enough for Toby to unleash the cut. Kagiso runs across to his right, slides to stop the ball but fails to keep the ball in play. More runs for him. He already has the best score for a Number 9 on debut for England. Promising signs.

FOUR! Lovely shot! Full and wide outside off, Roland-Jones does not back away and drives it beautifully through covers for a boundary. The fielder in the deep had no chance to cut it off. Too good a shot for a Number 9!
Straight, nearly squeezes through as it takes an inside edge into the leg side and they run through for a single.

SIX! He is not backing away from playing the pull shot. Short from Morris on the body of the batsman, Roland-Jones goes for the pull shot and gets a top edge which flies high and wide of the fine leg fielder for a maximum.
Very full, almost a yorker, the batsman goes for the flick but misses it and hits him low on the pads.
The batsman has driven it straight down the ground.
FOUR! SHOT! Short ball on his rib cage, Roland-Jones comes inside the land and pulls it fine past the leg gully fielder to the boundary. Also brings up the hundred for England.
Short ball, Roland-Jones tries to flick it but gets a leading edge, falls just short of Rabada who comes running in from mid on.
Leg gully in place. There is a man back for the hook at square leg. Expect some short stuff.
Short again, Roland-Jones tucks it on the leg side for a run.
Five Wides! Very short by Parnell and also down the leg side, the batsman sees it bounce over him and de Kock only manages to get a finger tip on it. Fails to stop it,  goes to the boundary.
Length ball, Roland-Jones drives it back to the bowler.
Short ball on the ribs off the batsman, Bairstow pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Beaten again! Length ball angling away, Bairstow tries to drive it through the covers but gets beaten on the outside edge.
BEATEN! Lazy shot from Bairstow, full outside off from Parnell, inviting the batsman to drive, he obliges and goes for a drive but gets beaten.
Just ahead of length, Bairstow drives it to mid off.
Another bouncer from Morris, Roland-Jones ducks under it and de Kock takes it high above his head.
Follows it up with a length ball outside off, Roland-Jones lets it through to the keeper.

Slight hold up in play as Toby's helmet is being changed. The physio is out as well. Richard Levi was taken to hospital yesterday after getting hit on his helmet during a county game. You don't want players to get hurt as much you enjoy watching good fast bowling.

OUCH! Some chin music for Roland-Jones! A well directed short ball from Morris, Roland-Jones goes for the pull shot. The ball hits his glove and then strikes him on the grill. Morris did not like begin driven down the ground on the previous delivery. Roland-Jones seems to be in a little trouble.
FOUR! First boundary in international cricket for Roland-Jones. Fuller length ball, the batsman plants his front foot forward and drives the ball on the up past mid off to the boundary.
Length ball on the stumps, Roland-Jones defends it off the front foot.
Good length outside off, the batsman lets it go through to the keeper.
Bairstow pushes it towards covers from his crease.
FOUR! Thumped! A shorter length ball on the stumps, Bairstow picks it up and nails the pull through square leg for a boundary. The umpire had to get out of the way.
Slants across a good length ball outside off, Bairstow cuts it towards backward point from his crease.
Good length around off, worked towards square leg off his crease.

Back of a length on middle, Roland-Jones tucks it towards square leg and takes a quick single. He gets off the mark. Phehlukwayo, the substitute is a touch slow to stop the ball. He is on the field for David Miller.
Toby Roland-Jones on his international debut, comes out to bat.

OUT! Willey throws it away! Parnell bowls it on a length just outside off, David goes for the thumping drive. He fails to keep it down and Duminy at short extra cover takes a sharp catch. A wicket at last for South Africa after the 62-run stand. Parnell takes his third.
Top work, Faf! Bairstow drives the full ball on off stump beautifully to covers, where Faf dives to his right and makes a superb stop to parry the ball towards mid off where AB makes the stop.
A well directed short ball by Morris but Willey is up to the task and pulls it to fine leg for a run.
Short delivery on the body of Willey. He goes for the pull but misses it and gets hit on the body.
Short ball just outside off, Bairstow cuts it into the ground, it bounces over the point fielder and they run through for a single.
Back of a length ball, Willey pushes it off the back foot through covers for a run.
Length ball, angling away, Willey defends it off the front foot towards the leg side.
Length ball, angling away, Bairstow tries to defend the ball but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
A tad fuller, Bairstow drives it back to the bowler.
Strays on the pads, flicks it off the pads through square leg for a run.
Pushes the length ball down the ground past the diving mid on fielder, who should have put in a better effort to stop the ball and they run two. Morkel was the fielder there.
Back of a length ball, Willey pushes it off the back foot to mid off.
Bowls it on a full length on off stump, Willey defends it off the front foot.
Wayne Parnell returns for a bowl.
Hits the length just around off, Bairstow drives it on the up to mid on. 11 runs from the over.
FOUR! Poor bowling! Short and wide by Morkel, Bairstow cuts it behind point for another boundary. Second boundary in the over.
Length on off stump, Willey pushes it past covers for a run.
50-run stand up between Bairstow and Willey.
Short on the body, Willey pulls it to deep square leg for a couple. This has been a good stand for the home side.
FOUR! Full length and a little bit of width on offer, Willey rocks back and punches it through cover-point for a boundary.
Lands it on a length, angling across the batsman, Willey gets forward and defends it.
Chris Morris called on for a bowl. South Africa will want to break this stand.
Back of a length, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Short on the body of the batsman, Willey gets inside the line and pulls it down to backward square leg for a single. That run also brings up his highest ODI score.
Drifts down the leg side, Willey misses the flick and it brushes his pads, de Kock makes a good stop diving to his right.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Short again outside off, Bairstow cuts it straight to point. Missed out on a boundary there.
FOUR! GREAT SHOT! Short ball on off stump, Bairstow upper cuts it over the keeper for a boundary. Morkel is bowling way too short in this spell.
Plays it with the turn towards mid-wicket.
Short ball outside off, Bairstow cuts it through point for a run.
Batsman defends the flighted ball off the front foot.
Comes down the track, drives the ball through mid on for a run.
Flatter ball, Bairstow goes on the back foot and pushes it past de Villiers at covers who gets a hand to it. A single taken.
Tosses it up on leg stump, the batsman tries to work it on the leg side but misses it and gets hit on the pads.
Drinks. England need it at the moment. The pair of Bairstow and Willey has done well to put up a fight. South Africa will aim to keep taking wickets and restrict the home side.
Bowls it wide outside off, Willey lets it go through to the keeper.
Full on the pads, the batsman flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Full length ball outside off, Bairstow lets it through to the keeper.
FOUR! Shot! Short and wide, Bairstow cuts it through point for a boundary. These two are ticking along well.
Short ball outside off, Bairstow lets it through to the keeper.
Back of a length on off, jags in a little, Bairstow misses his flick and is hit on the thigh pad.
Drives it down through mid off for a run.
Comes down the track and drives it down to long on for a single. 50 up for England. The crowd appreciates it.
Bowls it short, the batsman rocks back and pushes it through covers for a run.
Works the ball towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman comes down the wicket, gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Tosses it up, gets the ball to turn, Willey defends it off the front foot.
Drifts on the pads of Willey, who flicks it wide of mid-wicket for a single.
Comes round the wicket, bowls it on a length, Willey defends it off the back foot.
Length ball on middle, the batsman clips it through mid-wicket for a run.
A change in field. Square leg drops back.
Morkel bangs it in short, it takes off, Bairstow lets it go through to the keeper, who jumps and collects it with one hand.
Short ball on off stump, comes in with the angle, Bairstow gets out of the way and lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Lands it on a length outside off, Bairstow lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Flatter ball on off, Willey defends it off the back foot.
Defends the flighted delivery on the off side.
Floats it on middle, Willey plays it with the spin on the leg side.
On the pads, Bairstow flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
Tosses it up, Bairstow defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Starts off with a short one, Bairstow rocks back and punches it past diving short cover for a boundary.
Keshav Maharaj is brought into the attack.
The batsman guides the length ball down to third man for a single.
Length ball outside off, Bairstow watches it carefully and lets it through to the keeper.
Full and wide outside off, Willey drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Bowls it wide of off stump, Willey lets the ball go through to the keeper.
Shorter length ball, Willey is late on his shot and gets hit on the thigh pad. The ball rolls towards the slip region.
Bowls it outside off, Willey lets it go through to the keeper.
Finally a bowling change, Morne Morkel comes on for a bowl. He will be itching to perform, coming back to the side after a year.
FOUR! CRACKING SHOT! Full ball outside off, Bairstow plants his front foot forward and drives it beautifully past covers for a boundary.
Length ball, the batsman guides it down to third man, they run a couple. Good running there.

BIG APPEAL FOR LBW! Length ball comes in a little, Bairstow tries to drive it on the up, but gets beaten and gets hit high on the pads. They all go up in an appeal but the umpire gives it not out. Might be going over the stumps.
Tight bowling from Rabada, lands it on a length outside off, Bairstow shoulders his arms to it.
Defends the full length ball off the back foot.
Good leave by Bairstow, length ball outside off, jags in a little, the batsman lets it go through to the keeper.
Slashes and beaten again! Length ball outside off, Willey slashes at it and misses again.
Full length ball on off, Willey defends it off the front foot to extra cover.
BEATEN AGAIN! Lovely bowling from Parnell, on a good length, nips away off the deck with some extra bounce, Willey tries to defend it off the back foot but gets beaten again.
Short and wide outside off, Willey slashes and gets beaten. Lucky not to get an edge there.
Bowls it outside off, the batsman lets the ball go through to the keeper.
FOUR! THEY NEED A LOT MORE! Full on the pads of Willey, who flicks it through the vacant mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Bairstow lets the ball outside off stump go through to the keeper. Maiden from Rabada!
Bowls it on a length, the batsman defends it off the back foot towards point.
SNORTER! Rabada bangs it short and around off, Bairstow does well to duck under it.
Back of a length ball, outside off, Rabada gets some extra bounce off the surface, Bairstow lets it go.
The batsman has punched that ball through the off side.
Full length ball, Bairstow defends it off the front foot.
Rabada is on a hat-trick here. Two slips in place for him.

FOUR! LUCKY! Back of a length, Willey pushes tries to punch it through covers off the back foot. The ball takes the outside edge and flies between the third slip and gully fielders for a boundary down to third man.
Length ball, Willey tries to defend it off the back foot but gets an outside edge but falls short off gully.

Drifts on the pads, Bairstow flicks through square leg. Maharaj gets across from backward square leg, slides to stop the ball. He does so but fumbles as he looks to pick it up, tumbles but stops the ball eventually. The third umpire is referred to check if it was a clean stop. Replays show that it was. Three runs taken.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Lands it on a length, Bairstow defends it off the back foot.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Bairstow tries to tickle it but misses it and the umpire signals a wide.
Full length ball, the batsman defends it off the back foot. The crowd likes it.

David Willey is the new man in. Plenty of work to do. Crazy scenes really, Steven Finn was rushing to get back to the dressing room. He was having a hit in the nets with the bat. They will need him to score today.

OUT! What is happening out there? Somebody tell England to stop playing too many shots. Fuller delivery outside off, Rashid wants to play the expansive drive. He gets an outside edge which is snapped up by Faf du Plessis at second slip. Rabada has taken three in an over and two in two balls. He will be on a hat-trick next over. ENGLAND ARE 20 FOR 6!
Adil Rashid has come out to bat in just the fifth over of the innings. Not sure he would have expected that. There are two slips in place along with a short leg.

OUT! England are five down inside the first five overs. Full ball outside off by Rabada, Buttler goes for the drive but gets an outside edge, it goes quickly to Faf du Plessis who is at second slip, he takes a fine catch.
FOUR! POOR LINE! Drifts on the pads of the batsman, Buttler flicks it past the diving mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
BOUNCER! Bangs it short on the leg stump, Buttler ducks under it.
Length ball, Buttler defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side and is called wide by the umpire.

Jos Buttler walks out. England need to hold themselves back a bit. You can't play your big shots everyday, can you? They have had a lot of success with that game but today is going to be different for them. By the way, there is a leg gully in place for him.

OUT! Another one bites the dust, Hales goes this time! Full length ball swinging away, Hales goes for the drive but gets an outside edge straight to Amla at first slip who takes an easy catch. South Africa are running through the English top order.
Jonny Bairtsow comes out to bat. England under pressure here.

OUT! Third wicket for South Africa. What a start for them. Length ball outside off stump, Morgan pokes at it and gets an outside edge to the keeper. Morgan who was in good form departs, England are in big trouble here.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shorter length outside off, Morgan slashes at it but gets beaten and it goes through to the keeper.
Back of a length ball, Morgan defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Shot! Morgan comes down the track and hits this length ball over covers for a boundary. He is trying to stamp his authority here.
Full, looking for some swing. Morgan drives it off the middle of the bat to mid off.
Tad fuller, Morgan gets on the front foot and drives it to mid off for a run.
Rabada is given a warning for running on the wicket. We are not sure if it is an official one as of now. We shall update you about the same.
BOUNCER! A well directed bouncer and Morgan does well to evade it.
Back of a length ball, Morgan pushes it off the back foot through covers for a couple.
Length ball, nips away off the deck, Morgan looks to defend but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Back of a length, angling across, Morgan pushes it to point off the back foot.
YORKER! That was fast and Morgan was late to get down his bat and it just misses the off stump and goes through to the keeper.
Another inswinger in line of the stumps, Morgan tries to defend it but gets an inside edge down to fine leg for a run.
Eoin Morgan is the new man in. Four slips in place for him.

OUT! BIG, BIG WICKET! Parnell gets the big wicket of Joe Root. He bowls it full, the ball swings in late, Root misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The Proteas make a huge appeal and the umpire gives it out. That looked plumb and hence Root did not review it. England are in big trouble here, they lose their second wicket.
Back off a length, angling away, Root pushes it past point on the back foot for a couple.
Walks down the wicket, Parnell bowls it full, Root plays it to the point region.
Fuller length ball, swings into the batsman, Root gets an inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to the off side. Stifled appeal turned down.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, Hales squeezes it down to third man for a run.
Wayne Parnell to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Back of a length ball, skids through the surface, Root defends it off the back foot. Good over by Rabada.

Joe Root is the new man in for England. Three slips in place for him. Roy has faltered once again, he has not had a good time opening the batting. His last 5 scores in this format of the game are 4, 8, 1, 20, 0. The hosts would have ideally wanted him to come good going into the mega event.

OUT! GONE! Great comeback by Rabada, gets his man. Bowls it on a length outside off, gets a little movement away from the batsman. Roy pokes at the delivery and gets a thick outside edge and is pouched by Amla at first slip. Jason Roy's bad form continues. South Africa get an early breakthrough.
FOUR! Don't bowl on his pads! Strays on the pads of Roy and he flicks it behind square for a boundary. First runs of the day for England.
Bowls it on a shorter length but wide outside off, Roy lets it go through to the keeper.
BEATEN! Lands it on a length, nips away off the surface and beats the outside edge of Roy.
Starts off with a full ball, Roy drives it down to mid off.
The players and the umpires have walked out to the middle. Alex Hales and Jason Roy will open the batting for England. Kagiso Rabada will take the first new ball for South Africa.

TOSS - South Africa win the toss and opt to field. The visitors bring in Morne Morkel, Wayne Parnell and JP Duminy for Dwaine Pretorius, Farhaan Behardien and Andile Phehlukwayo. The hosts have made four changes to their side. Liam Plunkett, Mark Wood, Ben Stokes, Moeen Ali out for David Willey, Steven Finn, Toby Roland-Jones and Jonny Bairstow. For England, Toby Roland-Jones is making his international debut.

Welcome to Lord's for the third and final ODI between England and South Africa. This match between the two sides is a dead rubber as the hosts have already clinched the series. Ben Stokes, who was Man of the Match in the last game, along with Moeen Ali and Chris Woakes have been rested for this game. So we might see a lot of changes for them today. For the Proteas, they would want to win this game and avoid a whitewash. AB de Villiers is playing his 100th ODI today as a skipper and will want his side to step up. Both the teams will look forward to use this game to prepare for the Champions Trophy.
